caption: The drawing features two distinct objects, each centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. Both objects are ear ornaments rendered in warm golden and brown tones. The object on the left consists of a complex arrangement with a circular stud at the top, from which a hook extends downward, holding a teardrop-shaped centerpiece adorned with smaller, similarly shaped drops hanging in two tiers, all connected by small loops. The object on the right is simpler, comprising a round stud at the top, from which a thin vertical bar descends, passing through three interlinked golden hoops of decreasing size, ending with a small round bead at the bottom. The drawing is symmetrical in its layout, with the two objects spaced side by side in the center of the image, and there are no other visible elements in the composition.
title: Earrings
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
